hook_text: Your muscles can pull, but they can never push. So how do you straighten your arm?
clip_script: Pantsula practice in Soweto. Kick, stamp, spin. Freeze! Bend your elbow. Feel the front of your arm bulge? That is the biceps pulling. Now straighten it. The biceps relaxes, and the triceps at the back pulls instead. Muscles only pull, so they work in pairs. Tendons tie them to the bones. Joints are where the bones bend: hinges at the knees, ball and socket at the hips. Now, music back on!
visual_style: Whiteboard dancer frozen mid-kick, with arm muscles drawn as two elastic bands that tighten in turn.
mood: Lively and rhythmic, like a dance class with pop quizzes.
pacing: Dance, freeze, explain one idea, dance again, three times over.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and build a cardboard model arm.
